title: Parse what the model actually sends back
checks: A fenced, chatty answer is rescued
No JSON at all is a clear error
_raises(lambda: extract('I could not create the ticket.'), ValueError)
A valid ticket gets default tags

parse_ticket('{"ticket_id": "881", "priority": "urgent", "summary": "Hi", "tags": ["a", 2]}') == (None, ['priority: must be one of low, medium, high', 'summary: must be at least 5 characters', 'tags: must be a list of strings', 'ticket_id: must look like TCK-123'])
The retry message lists each error and asks for JSON only
(lambda m: m.count('\n- ') + m.startswith('- ') == 2 and 'json' in m.lower())(retry_prompt(['priority: must be one of low, medium, high', 'summary: must be at least 5 characters']))
